🚀 Ready to use Data & AI to solve real-world agricultural challenges?

📅 Join Databricks and Corteva on Saturday, October 10, 2026 for a day of hands-on learning, industry networking, and a hackathon focused on applying data and AI to agriculture.

Databricks and Corteva Agriscience engineers will kick off the day with an introduction to:

✅ The Databricks platform and how Corteva uses it in practice
✅ Interactive demos and hands-on exercises
✅ Networking opportunities with industry experts
✅ Complimentary Breakfast/Lunch/Snacks provided

🌱 Hackathon Challenge: Data & AI for Yield Preservation

In the Afternoon, participants will work in teams to tackle a real-world challenge focused on Data & AI for Yield Preservation. Using data-driven approaches and AI tools, you'll explore innovative solutions to help address challenges faced by agricultural engineers and researchers.


Why attend?

🔹 Build confidence working with Databricks technologies
🔹 Learn practical, in-demand data and AI skills
🔹 Gain experience solving real industry challenges
🔹 Connect with Databricks and Corteva engineers and leaders
🔹 Compete for exclusive swag 

Who should attend?

🎓 Open to all Graduate Iowa State University students
💻 Bring your laptop (required)

🎉 Congratulations to Dr. Soumik Sarkar, Professor of Mechanical Engineering, on receiving Iowa State University's Award for Mid-Career Achievement in Research! This award, recognizing outstanding research at the mid-career stage as evaluated by peers, is a well-earned milestone.

As founding director of the Iowa State Translational AI Center (TrAC) and associate director of the $20M AI Institute for Resilient Agriculture, Soumik has pioneered the integration of AI, machine learning, and cyber-physical systems to advance sustainable agriculture. 

A few highlights:
📊 312 peer-reviewed publications, 13,700+ citations, h-index of 52
 💰 $56.7M+ in external research funding (NSF, DARPA, USDA, NIH, AFOSR, USDOT)
 🎓 31 graduate students mentored, now at Nvidia, Intel, Amazon, Bayer, Raytheon, and MIT

Congratulations, Soumik — thank you for your leadership at the Translational AI Center! 👏

🎉 Congratulations to Dr. Baskar Ganapathysubramanian, Associate Director of the Translational AI Center, on being named a Distinguished Professor — Iowa State University's highest academic honor! 🎉

It's a privilege to work alongside Baskar and see firsthand the vision and dedication he brings to advancing translational AI research every day. This recognition is a fitting tribute to that impact.

Since 2021, Baskar has directed the AI Institute for Resilient Agriculture, driving cross-disciplinary research with real-world impact across agriculture, energy, water, and advanced materials. His work includes 225+ publications, 13,000+ citations, and over $50M in research funding, along with contributions to national efforts like the White House OSTP and the National AI Research Resource initiative.

This honor reflects a career of research excellence — and we're proud to have his leadership at the Translational AI Center. Congratulations, Baskar! 👏

🚀 Ready to take your machine learning skills from experimentation to production?

Join the upcoming MLOps – Machine Learning Operations micro-credential course offered by the Translational AI Center at Iowa State University. This hands-on course will introduce participants to the tools and practices used to build, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models in real-world environments. 

Topics include MLflow, data pipelines, REST APIs, and containerization. 

📅 Instructional Period: October 5–30, 2026
⏱️ Course Hours: 16 Hours

🏅 Last Day to Earn Badge: November 30, 2026 

Whether you're a student, researcher, software engineer, data scientist, or technology professional, this course will help you gain practical MLOps skills and learn how to build end-to-end machine learning workflows for production environments
